title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
title_zh: BASA——适用于多种后端的高效稀疏注意力机制：快速高分辨率视觉生成研究

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52 × \times attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality. Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/lama0110/BASA .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器（DiTs）在图像和视频生成方面取得了优异表现，但全注意力机制的二次复杂度使得高分辨率生成的计算成本高昂。 窗口注意力提供了一种高效的替代方案，但现有方法面临一个实际权衡：分块窗口注意力通常实现的计算效率与其理论复杂度一致。 然而，孤立的窗口会阻断跨窗口的交互，常常在生成结果中引入明显的网格状伪影。 细粒度滑动窗口注意力有效恢复了相邻窗口之间的交互，并提升了视觉质量。 不过，其不规则的计算模式导致理论与实际加速效果之间存在显著差距，并且需要为每种硬件后端定制专用内核。 为解决这些挑战，我们提出了BASA——一种与后端无关的稀疏注意力机制，它融合了两种优势：卓越的视觉质量和实际加速效果。 具体而言，BASA用移位局部窗口注意力取代了视觉自注意力。 通过在DiT块中引入结构化的窗口移位方案，我们使得一层中被窗口边界分割的标记能够在后续层中进行交互，从而实现全局信息交换并消除由窗口引起的视觉伪影。 值得注意的是，我们的设计未引入任何额外的不规则算子或定制内核，因此可以直接部署在现有的注意力后端上，并弥合了理论稀疏性与实际加速效果之间的差距。 实验表明，BASA在FLUX模型上实现的实测加速效果超过了理论估计值的90%，并在Wan模型上实现了4.52 × 的注意力加速，同时保持了具有竞争力的生成质量。 代码可在以下地址公开获取：https://github.com/lama0110/BASA 。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have achieved strong performance in image and video generation ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) . By combining diffusion modeling with the contextual capacity of Transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a dominant backbone for modern image ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Bao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Esser et al., 2024 ) and video generation ( Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan Team et al., 2025 ) . However, the quadratic complexity of Transformer self-attention makes dense attention increasingly costly when pre-trained visual generation models are extended to higher resolutions.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型在图像和视频生成方面取得了卓越的性能（Ho 等人，2020；Rombach 等人，2022）。 通过将扩散建模与 Transformer 的上下文建模能力相结合（Vaswani 等人，2017），扩散 Transformer（DiTs）已成为现代图像（Peebles 和 Xie，2023；Bao 等人，2023；Chen 等人，2024b；Esser 等人，2024）和视频生成（Kong 等人，2024；Wan Team 等人，2025）的主流骨干架构。 然而，Transformer 自注意力的二次复杂度使得，当预训练的视觉生成模型扩展到更高分辨率时，密集注意力机制的成本会越来越高。

sents.zh: 然而，Transformer 自注意力的二次复杂度使得，当预训练的视觉生成模型扩展到更高分辨率时，密集注意力机制的成本会越来越高。

paragraphs.en: Window attention offers a natural alternative by restricting self-attention to local regions. Conventional partitioned window attention, as in Swin ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , divides tokens into regular non-overlapping windows. This structured pattern can be efficiently executed by existing dense attention operators, allowing measured acceleration to closely track theoretical savings. However, isolated windows block direct cross-boundary interaction, disrupting continuous textures and structures and producing visible grid-like artifacts, especially under substantial resolution extrapolation.
paragraphs.zh: 窗口注意力通过将自注意力限制在局部区域，提供了一种自然的替代方案。 传统的分区窗口注意力（如 Swin (Liu et al., 2021) 中的方法）将标记划分为规则且不重叠的窗口。 这种结构化模式可以通过现有的密集注意力算子高效执行，从而实现可控的加速，并紧密跟踪理论上的性能提升。 然而，孤立的窗口会阻碍直接的跨边界交互，破坏连续的纹理和结构，并产生可见的网格状伪影，尤其是在大幅分辨率外推的情况下。

paragraphs.en: Fine-grained sliding-window attention instead uses overlapping local neighborhoods to improve cross-boundary interaction and local continuity. CLEAR ( Liu et al., 2025 ) uses conv-like linearization to preserve locality, attention formulation, and raw visual features for pre-trained image DiTs, while STA ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) uses sliding spatiotemporal tiles to exploit redundancy and locality in video attention. However, fine-grained sliding-window attention presents two practical challenges. First, irregular computational patterns incur indexing and memory-access overhead, creating a substantial gap between theoretical and measured speedups. Second, efficient execution often relies on specialized kernels tailored to individual hardware backends, increasing implementation costs and limiting portability.
paragraphs.zh: 细粒度滑动窗口注意力机制则使用重叠的局部邻域，以增强跨边界交互和局部连续性。 CLEAR（Liu 等人，2025）采用类卷积的线性化方法，以保留预训练图像 DiT 的局部性、注意力形式和原始视觉特征；而 STA（Zhang 等人，2025b）则使用滑动时空分块，以利用视频注意力中的冗余性和局部性。 然而，细粒度滑动窗口注意力机制存在两个实际挑战。 首先，不规则的计算模式会带来索引和内存访问的额外开销，导致理论加速与实际测量加速之间存在显著差距。 其次，高效执行通常依赖于为特定硬件后端量身定制的专用内核，这会增加实现成本并限制可移植性。

sents.en: Second, efficient execution often relies on specialized kernels tailored to individual hardware backends, increasing implementation costs and limiting portability.
sents.zh: 其次，高效执行通常依赖于为特定硬件后端量身定制的专用内核，这会增加实现成本并限制可移植性。

paragraphs.en: These limitations call for a sparse attention design that combines cross-window communication, regular computation, and backend portability. Fig. 2 illustrates the quality–efficiency trade-off: regular partitioned windows provide strong practical acceleration but exhibit boundary artifacts, whereas fine-grained sliding windows improve visual continuity with smaller measured speed gains. The key question is therefore how to enable cross-window communication while retaining regular window computation and avoiding backend-specific custom kernels.
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性要求一种稀疏注意力设计，该设计需结合跨窗口通信、常规计算和后端可移植性。 图 2 展示了质量与效率之间的权衡：常规的分区窗口能提供显著的实际加速效果，但会出现边界伪影；而精细的滑动窗口虽然能改善视觉连续性，但实测速度提升较小。 因此，关键问题在于如何在保留常规窗口计算的同时实现跨窗口通信，并避免使用特定于后端的定制内核。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose BASA , a b ackend- a gnostic s parse a ttention mechanism for efficient high-resolution image and video generation. BASA retains regular local windows but varies their spatial partition offsets across DiT blocks and denoising steps. Tokens separated by one partition can thus interact under subsequent partitions, enabling cross-window information propagation while preserving regular attention computation within each block. BASA further augments each query window with spatially pooled global K/V memory to provide low-cost scene-level context. For video, content-adaptive routing retrieves a small number of relevant uncompressed spatial windows, preserving fine-grained long-range information and the full temporal extent of each selected region.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 BASA——一种后端无关的稀疏注意力机制，用于高效生成高分辨率图像和视频。 BASA 保留了常规的局部窗口，但会在不同 DiT 块和去噪步骤中改变其空间分区偏移量。 因此，由一个分区隔开的标记可以在后续分区中相互作用，从而实现跨窗口的信息传播，同时保持每个块内常规注意力计算的完整性。 BASA 还进一步为每个查询窗口增加了经过空间池化的全局 K/V 记忆，以提供低成本的场景级上下文信息。 对于视频，内容自适应路由会检索少量相关的未压缩空间窗口，从而保留精细的长距离信息以及每个选定区域完整的时序范围。

paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention framework that addresses the trade-off between hardware-efficient regular sparsity and effective cross-window communication in high-resolution visual generation. BASA enables practical acceleration without relying on customized sparse kernels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BASA，一个与后端无关的稀疏注意力框架，旨在解决高分辨率视觉生成中硬件高效的常规稀疏性与有效跨窗口通信之间的权衡问题。 BASA 无需依赖定制的稀疏内核即可实现实际加速。

sents.zh: 我们提出了 BASA，一个与后端无关的稀疏注意力框架，旨在解决高分辨率视觉生成中硬件高效的常规稀疏性与有效跨窗口通信之间的权衡问题。

sents.en: BASA enables practical acceleration without relying on customized sparse kernels.

paragraphs.en: We further develop a structured sparse attention design combining shifted local windows with K/V-pooled global memory, and extend it to video with content-adaptive true-window routing. Varying window partitions promote cross-window information propagation, while global memory and routed windows provide efficient long-range context. Dense-teacher adaptation is further used to reduce sparse–dense discrepancy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步开发了一种结构化稀疏注意力设计，将移位局部窗口与 K/V 池化全局内存相结合，并将其扩展到视频领域，采用内容自适应的真实窗口路由。 不同的窗口分区促进了跨窗口的信息传播，而全局内存和路由窗口则提供了高效的全局上下文信息。 我们还进一步采用了密集教师适配器，以减少稀疏与密集模式之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Pre-trained visual diffusion models often suffer from repeated objects, structural distortions, and layout inconsistencies when extrapolated beyond their training resolution. Existing training-free approaches mitigate this issue from different perspectives. MultiDiffusion ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) fuses overlapping diffusion trajectories, ScaleCrafter ( He et al., 2024 ) adapts effective receptive fields, while DemoFusion ( Du et al., 2024a ) and DiffuseHigh ( Kim et al., 2025 ) perform progressive high-resolution refinement. FreeScale ( Qiu et al., 2025b ) explores multi-scale feature fusion, AccDiffusion ( Lin et al., 2024 ) improves patch-wise extrapolation through patch-aware conditioning, and HiDiffusion ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) modifies feature resolution and shifted-window attention. Recent methods including I-Max ( Du et al., 2024b ) , HiFlow ( Bu et al., 2025 ) , and UltraImage ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) further investigate resolution extrapolation for flow/DiT models through projected flow, trajectory alignment, and positional attention, while EditBridge ( Song et al., 2026 ) extends efficient high-resolution processing to ultra-high-resolution image editing. Beyond training-free extrapolation, URAE ( Yu et al., 2025 ) explores efficient adaptation of pre-trained diffusion models for ultra-high-resolution generation.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练的视觉扩散模型在超出其训练分辨率进行外推时，常常会出现物体重复、结构失真和布局不一致等问题。 现有的无需训练的方法从不同视角出发，缓解了这一问题。 MultiDiffusion（Bar-Tal 等，2023）融合了重叠的扩散轨迹，ScaleCrafter（He 等，2024）调整了有效的感受野，而 DemoFusion（Du 等，2024a）和 DiffuseHigh（Kim 等，2025）则执行了渐进式的高分辨率优化。 FreeScale（Qiu 等，2025b）探索了多尺度特征融合，AccDiffusion（Lin 等，2024）通过感知补丁的条件约束提升了逐块外推能力，而 HiDiffusion（Zhang 等，2024）则修改了特征分辨率和移位窗口注意力机制。 近期方法包括 I-Max（Du 等，2024b）、HiFlow（Bu 等，2025）和 UltraImage（Zhao 等，2025），它们通过投影流、轨迹对齐和位置注意力进一步研究了流/DiT 模型的分辨率外推问题，而 EditBridge（Song 等，2026）则将高效的高分辨率处理扩展到了超高分辨率图像编辑领域。 除了无需训练的外推方法，URAE（Yu 等，2025）还探索了将预训练的扩散模型高效适配于超高分辨率生成的方法。

paragraphs.en: High-resolution video generation introduces additional spatiotemporal challenges. UltraGen ( Hu et al., 2026 ) adopts hierarchical local–global attention, CineScale ( Qiu et al., 2025a ) uses tiled self-attention with positional adaptation, FreeSwim ( Wu et al., 2026 ) revisits sliding-window attention with semantic guidance and caching, Scale-DiT ( Zhang and Tai, 2025 ) combines high-resolution local computation with global guidance, and ApertureAttn ( Yu et al., 2026 ) targets native 4K video generation with image-only supervision. Different from these high-resolution generation and extrapolation methods, our work focuses on backend-compatible structured sparsity to reduce DiT self-attention cost and bridge theoretical savings with practical wall-clock acceleration.
paragraphs.zh: 高分辨率视频生成带来了额外的时空挑战。 UltraGen（Hu 等人，2026）采用了分层局部-全局注意力机制；CineScale（Qiu 等人，2025a）使用了带有位置自适应的块状自注意力；FreeSwim（Wu 等人，2026）重新探索了结合语义引导和缓存的滑动窗口注意力；Scale-DiT（Zhang 和 Tai，2025）将高分辨率局部计算与全局引导相结合；而 ApertureAttn（Yu 等人，2026）则针对原生 4K 视频生成，仅通过图像监督进行训练。 与上述高分辨率生成和外推方法不同，我们的工作专注于后端兼容的结构化稀疏性，以降低 DiT 自注意力的计算成本，并弥合理论上的效率提升与实际运行时间的加速之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention reduces the cost of enlarged visual token sequences by restricting interactions to local windows, neighborhoods, or blocks ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Hassani et al., 2023 ; Hassani et al., 2025 ) . Regular non-overlapping windows are attractive for practical acceleration because they can be reorganized into compact dense attention calls, but fixed boundaries may disrupt spatial continuity in pre-trained generative models. Recent methods therefore adopt finer-grained patterns to better preserve dense-attention behavior. CLEAR ( Liu et al., 2025 ) emphasizes locality and feature integrity, STA ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) uses sliding tiles with head-dependent windows, Sparse VideoGen and Sparse VideoGen2 exploit head-wise and semantic structures ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , and VSA ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) identifies important regions through pooled representations. However, such sliding, head-dependent, or content-dependent patterns often require specialized execution, so FLOP reductions may not translate into proportional wall-clock speedup.
paragraphs.zh: 稀疏注意力通过将交互限制在局部窗口、邻域或块内，降低了扩展后的视觉令牌序列的成本（Liu et al., 2021；Hassani et al., 2023；Hassani et al., 2025）。 规则的无重叠窗口在实际加速中颇具吸引力，因为它们可以被重新组织为紧凑的密集注意力调用，但固定的边界可能会破坏预训练生成模型中的空间连续性。 因此，近期方法采用了更精细的模式，以更好地保留密集注意力的行为。 CLEAR（Liu et al., 2025）强调局部性和特征完整性，STA（Zhang et al., 2025b）使用滑动瓦片和依赖头的窗口，Sparse VideoGen 和 Sparse VideoGen2 利用逐头和语义结构（Xi et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2025），而 VSA（Zhang et al., 2025a）则通过池化表示识别重要区域。 然而，这类滑动、依赖头或依赖内容的模式通常需要专门的执行方式，因此 FLOP 的减少可能不会带来成比例的实时加速效果。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate BASA on FLUX.1-dev ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan Team et al., 2025 ) for image and video resolution extrapolation, comparing generation quality and attention efficiency against representative sparse attention methods. paragraphs.en: We use dense FLUX outputs under identical conditions as references. paragraphs.en: For video evaluation, we randomly sample 20 prompts from VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and generate five samples per prompt, yielding 100 videos in total. Dense Wan first generates an 81-frame source video at 832 × 480 832\times 480 and 15 fps as suggested by Wan2.1 paper ( Wan Team et al., 2025 ) . All methods then extrapolate the same source video by a factor of two along both spatial dimensions, producing a 1664 × 960 1664\times 960 video. We use 50 denoising steps and a classifier-free guidance scale of 5.0.

paragraphs.en: The results also confirm that FLOP reduction alone does not guarantee practical acceleration. CLEAR, Swin, and STA have high theoretical sparsity but low MFU, resulting in limited wall-clock speedups, while our method keeps the same performance in the model as theoretical advantage.
paragraphs.zh: 结果还证实，仅通过减少 FLOP 并不能保证实现实际加速。 CLEAR、Swin 和 STA 虽然具有高度的理论稀疏性，但 MFU 较低，导致实际运行时间的加速效果有限；而我们的方法在保持模型原有性能的同时，实现了理论上的优势。

paragraphs.en: Efficient high-resolution generation requires translating theoretical attention savings into practical speedup without sacrificing quality. We presented BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention framework that combines regular local attention with cross-window and long-range information exchange. Using only standard Q/K/V projections and SDPA, BASA requires no customized sparse kernels. Experiments on FLUX and Wan show that BASA narrows the gap between theoretical and measured acceleration for both image and video generation, while maintaining stable quality with reasonably sized windows. These results demonstrate the practicality of backend-compatible structured sparsity for efficient high-resolution generation.
paragraphs.zh: 高效的高分辨率生成需要将理论上的注意力节省转化为实际的速度提升，同时不牺牲质量。 我们提出了 BASA，一个与后端无关的稀疏注意力框架，它将常规局部注意力与跨窗口和长距离信息交换相结合。 BASA 仅使用标准的 Q/K/V 投影和 SDPA，无需任何定制的稀疏内核。 在 FLUX 和 Wan 上的实验表明，BASA 缩小了图像和视频生成中理论与实测加速之间的差距，同时在合理大小的窗口下保持了稳定的质量。 这些结果证明了后端兼容的结构化稀疏性在高效高分辨率生成中的实用性。

paragraphs.en: The practical efficiency of BASA follows not only from reducing the number of query–key interactions, but also from preserving a regular execution pattern. For resolutions exactly divisible by the window size, the implementation first applies a cyclic spatial shift and then converts the visual features into non-overlapping windows using only reshape and permutation operations. Therefore, the dominant sparse computation is executed as regular dense attention problems rather than through query-dependent sparse indexing, mask materialization, or a customized sparse-attention kernel. Pooled K/V memory is similarly constructed through regular spatial reshape and reduction.

paragraphs.en: Consequently, BASA expresses most of its reduced computation as a small number of regular dense attention calls that can be handled directly by optimized SDPA/FlashAttention backends. This is important because FLOP reduction alone does not guarantee proportional wall-clock acceleration: fine-grained or query-dependent sparse patterns may incur substantial indexing, masking, kernel-launch, and irregular memory-access overheads. BASA largely avoids these costs, allowing its measured acceleration to more closely track its theoretical MSA reduction. The correspondence is not expected to be exact, since reshape, pooling, branch merging, and kernel-launch overheads remain, and very small windows may also reduce kernel utilization. Nevertheless, the regular formulation substantially narrows the gap between theoretical and realized speedup without requiring specialized sparse kernels.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，BASA 将其大部分计算量的减少体现为少量规则的稠密注意力调用，这些调用可以直接由经过优化的 SDPA/FlashAttention 后端处理。 这一点很重要，因为仅靠减少 FLOP 并不一定能保证计算时间成比例地缩短：精细粒度或依赖查询的稀疏模式可能会产生大量的索引、掩码、内核启动和不规则内存访问开销。 BASA 在很大程度上避免了这些成本，使其测得的速度提升能够更紧密地反映其理论上的 MSA 减少量。 这种对应关系预计不会完全精确，因为重塑、池化、分支合并和内核启动的开销仍然存在，而且极小的窗口也可能降低内核利用率。 尽管如此，这种规则的公式形式在没有专用稀疏内核的情况下，显著缩小了理论速度提升与实际速度提升之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Our sparse models are adapted from the corresponding pre-trained dense models using a dense-teacher distillation protocol following CLEAR ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . For FLUX, we use the same 10K self-generated 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 training images as CLEAR and retain its data preprocessing and optimization pipeline. We make two implementation-level modifications for BASA. First, instead of full fine-tuning the attention parameters, we adopt LoRA for parameter-efficient adaptation. LoRA modules with rank 128 and scaling parameter 128 are inserted into the original attention Q/K/V and output projections, while the pre-trained transformer, VAE, and text encoders remain frozen. Second, the sparse attention pattern is updated during training to expose the student to the shifted partitions used at inference. Since training samples a single noisy timestep rather than running a complete denoising trajectory, we cycle the BASA shift index across optimization steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的稀疏模型是根据 CLEAR（Liu 等人，2025）提出的密集教师蒸馏协议，从对应的预训练密集模型适配而来的。 对于 FLUX，我们使用了与 CLEAR 相同的 10K 张自生成的 1024 × 1024 训练图像，并保留了其数据预处理和优化流程。 我们对 BASA 进行了两项实现层面的修改。 首先，我们没有对注意力参数进行完整的微调，而是采用 LoRA 来实现参数高效的适配。 我们将秩为 128、缩放参数为 128 的 LoRA 模块插入到原始的注意力 Q/K/V 和输出投影中，而预训练的 transformer、VAE 和文本编码器则保持冻结状态。 其次，在训练过程中会更新稀疏注意力模式，使学生模型能够接触到推理阶段使用的偏移分区。 由于训练时仅对单个含噪时间步进行采样，而非运行完整的去噪轨迹，因此我们会在优化步骤中循环切换 BASA 的偏移索引。

paragraphs.en: For FLUX.1-dev, we follow the high-resolution SDEdit protocol of CLEAR. We randomly sample 1,000 prompts from the COCO2014 validation captions. For each prompt, dense FLUX first generates a 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 source image using 20 denoising steps and guidance scale 3.5. The source image is bicubically resized to 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 and then used to initialize the high-resolution SDEdit stage. This stage uses 20 denoising steps, SDEdit strength 0.7, guidance scale 7.5, RoPE NTK factor 10, and proportional attention. Following the CLEAR high-resolution configuration, we disable scheduler dynamic shifting and set the scheduler time-shift parameter to 10. All of the experiments in this paper, including the quality samples generation, was conducted on single NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 FLUX.1-dev，我们遵循 CLEAR 的高分辨率 SDEdit 协议。 我们从 COCO2014 验证集标题中随机采样了 1,000 个提示词。 对于每个提示词，密集 FLUX 首先通过 20 次去噪步骤和引导尺度 3.5 生成一张 1024 × 1024 的源图像。 该源图像被双三次插值缩放至 2048 × 2048，然后用于初始化高分辨率 SDEdit 阶段。 该阶段使用 20 次去噪步骤、SDEdit 强度 0.7、引导尺度 7.5、RoPE NTK 因子 10 以及比例注意力机制。 遵循 CLEAR 的高分辨率配置，我们禁用了调度器的动态偏移，并将调度器时间偏移参数设为 10。 本文中的所有实验，包括质量样本的生成，均在单块 NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU 上执行。

paragraphs.en: All compared methods use exactly the same low-resolution source images, captions, random seeds, and high-resolution generation settings. Unless otherwise specified, the pooling factor is p = 4 p=4 ; the window size is varied according to the configuration reported in the main tables. paragraphs.en: BASA sparsifies only the spatial dimensions and always preserves the complete temporal extent of a selected spatial window. Window size w = ( w h , w w ) w=(w_{h},w_{w}) and pooling factor p = ( p h , p w ) p=(p_{h},p_{w}) are specified on the latent spatial grid as reported in the main tables. In the content-adaptive routing branch, each query window retrieves one additional true K/V window ( K = 1 K=1 ) from its configured candidate neighborhood; the implementation uses a candidate-window radius of one unless otherwise specified. Both pooled global memory and true-window routing are enabled for the full BASA model. This routing configuration is shared across denoising steps, while the spatial-window partition follows the shifted-window schedule. All methods use the same 81-frame V2V pipeline and generation settings, so differences in quality and efficiency arise from the attention processor rather than from different sampling protocols.

paragraphs.en: BASA is implemented at the attention-processor level without modifying the surrounding FLUX or Wan pipelines. For FLUX, spatial windows are formed by cyclic shift, reshape, and permutation, and the layer-specific partition metadata is updated at each denoising step. The resulting local windows are folded into the batch dimension and executed through standard SDPA. Pooled memory is produced by regular spatial reduction. The LoRA weights are merged into the corresponding attention projections for inference, leaving the external model interface unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: BASA 在注意力处理器层级实现，无需修改周围的 FLUX 或 Wan 流程。 对于 FLUX，空间窗口通过循环移位、重塑和置换形成，且每层特定的分区元数据会在每个去噪步骤中更新。 生成的局部窗口会被折叠到批次维度，并通过标准的 SDPA 执行。 池化内存由常规的空间降维生成。 LoRA 权重在推理时会合并到对应的注意力投影中，而外部模型接口保持不变。

paragraphs.en: For image efficiency measurements, we profile the complete attention-processor call with CUDA events after warm-up. The measurement includes Q/K/V projections, positional encoding, attention computation, and output projection, but excludes the VAE, text encoders, scheduler, image I/O, and other generation pipeline components. Compilation and autotuning are performed during warm-up and are excluded from the reported latency. CUDA synchronization is applied before collecting elapsed times. The same hardware, numerical precision, input shapes, and timing convention are used for all compared attention implementations. Video latency is measured under the same attention-only convention after warm-up. Therefore, the reported speedups reflect differences in the attention implementations rather than unrelated pipeline overheads.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测量图像处理的效率，我们在预热阶段之后使用 CUDA 事件对完整的注意力处理器调用进行性能分析。 该测量包括 Q/K/V 投影、位置编码、注意力计算和输出投影，但不包括 VAE、文本编码器、调度器、图像 I/O 以及其他生成流程组件。 编译和自动调优在预热阶段完成，并不计入所报告的延迟时间。 在收集经过的时间之前，会应用 CUDA 同步机制。 所有对比的注意力实现均使用相同的硬件、数值精度、输入形状和计时约定。 视频延迟在预热之后，按照相同的“仅注意力”约定进行测量。 因此，所报告的速度提升反映了注意力实现之间的差异，而非与注意力无关的流程开销。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 further validates the three components on video extrapolation. Removing shifted windows causes the largest overall degradation, reducing Aesthetic Quality from 56.87% to 50.76% and Dynamic Degree from 0.34 to 0.29, highlighting the importance of cross-window propagation for coherent spatial structures and natural motion. Removing pooled global memory decreases subject consistency, background consistency, and motion smoothness, while Imaging Quality remains similar, indicating that global memory mainly supports scene-level and temporal consistency. Removing routing has less effect on local smoothness but reduces Dynamic Degree from 0.34 to 0.29 and Imaging Quality from 67.02% to 65.94%, showing the benefit of retrieving relevant uncompressed distant windows for fine-grained long-range information.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 进一步验证了视频外推的三个组件。 移除偏移窗口会导致最严重的整体性能下降，将美学质量从 56.87% 降至 50.76%，动态程度从 0.34 降至 0.29，凸显了跨窗口传播对于保持连贯空间结构和自然运动的重要性。 移除全局池化内存会降低主体一致性、背景一致性和运动平滑度，而成像质量则基本保持不变，表明全局内存主要支持场景级和时间上的一致性。 移除路由对局部平滑度的影响较小，但会将动态程度从 0.34 降至 0.29，并将成像质量从 67.02% 降至 65.94%，说明检索相关的未压缩远端窗口有助于获取精细的长距离信息。

paragraphs.zh: 一个未来主义的机器人正在照料一片散发着生物发光光芒的花园，它的金属双手轻柔地抚弄着植物，背景中是星瀑倾泻，画面超精细、照片级真实、超高清、8K，光线空灵梦幻，将自然与科技完美融合。

paragraphs.en: A powerful scene of waves crashing against a rugged ocean cliff during a brewing thunderstorm. Dark clouds churn overhead, illuminated occasionally by bright flashes of lightning that reveal the textures of the cliffside. Seaspray rises with each impact of the waves, catching subtle highlights from the stormy sky. Wind-bent grasses cling to the rocks, adding movement and life to the scene. High-resolution 8k quality, dramatic lighting, and ultra-detailed natural textures emphasize the raw power of nature.
paragraphs.zh: 一场暴风雨即将来临之际，巨浪猛烈撞击着崎岖的海岸悬崖，场面震撼人心。 乌云在头顶翻涌，偶尔被明亮的闪电照亮，凸显出悬崖表面的纹理细节。 海浪每一次撞击都会激起海雾，在阴沉的天空下捕捉到微妙的闪光。 被风吹弯的草叶紧贴在岩石上，为整个场景增添了动感与生机。 高分辨率的8K画质、戏剧性的光影效果以及超细腻的自然纹理，突显了大自然原始而强大的力量。
